messages:
Nora (ACME): Hey team, after the model flip at ~10:05UTC our ingest broke. Parser fails with SyntaxError: Unexpected token / in JSON at position 42. sample response attached.
Jordan (CS): Thanks Nora — can you paste the raw response body you received? Any request id or timestamp?
Nora (ACME): here's one raw body (copied from logs):
```
// confidence: 0.87
{
  \"order_id\": 12345, // original order id
  \"items\": [
    {\"sku\": \"X1\", \"qty\": 2}/* price omitted for privacy */
  ]
}
```
Nora (ACME): The client uses a strict JSON parser (no comments allowed). This used to be pure JSON before the release.
Jordan (CS): ack. That looks like JS-style comments inserted into the payload. Are you hitting the hosted API or Dedicated?
Nora (ACME): hosted. model: r-infer-v2.0 (we pinned an older model but our router flipped to v2 on the rollout).
Liam (SRE): :eyes: deploy-bot shows a canary at 10:02UTC for r-infer-v2.0 with flag debug_annotate = true.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for service=runtime model=r-infer-v2.0 id=canary-2024-10-04-1002
Priya (Eng:runtime): Hi all — that debug_annotate flag was meant to add ephemeral comments in logs only, not in production responses. Investigating why comments leaked into payloads.
Jordan (CS): Nora — can you also send the request headers (esp. x-request-id) and the exact API endpoint you called?
Nora (ACME): x-request-id: a8f3-11ea-9c2b-0a1b2c3d4e5f, endpoint: POST /v1/generate/chat
Nora (ACME): Happens intermittently: ~3/20 requests have comments in body, the rest are clean.
Priya (Eng:runtime): repro steps appreciated. Liam — can you grep the runtime logs for that x-request-id? I'll check the code path that injects annotations.
Liam (SRE): Found 3 matches around 10:04-10:07UTC. Snippet from runtime stdout: 
```
[info] request a8f3... processing
[debug] annotate: adding debug comment to response
[debug] serialized output -> sending
```
Liam (SRE): Looks like a side-effect: the annotate middleware appended comments to the serialized buffer before flush.
Priya (Eng:runtime): Reproduced locally with the flag on. root cause: a helper used for human-readable debug comments wrote to the same io.Writer as the JSON encoder. Patch incoming to isolate debug writer and strip comments from production path.
Jordan (CS): Action items: 1) rollback canary or flip flag off; 2) hotfix to runtime to prevent annotation in responses; 3) add unit test and a contract test to catch comment characters in output.
Liam (SRE): I've flipped debug_annotate=false for the canary pool at 10:20UTC. Monitoring now.
deploy-bot: Flag update applied: debug_annotate=false on pool canary-2024-10-04-1002
Nora (ACME): Thanks — we still saw 1 failing call at 10:21UTC but none after 10:23UTC. Looks much better.
Priya (Eng:runtime): Working on PR: runtime:ensure-no-comment-annotate. Will add a regression test that scans outputs for /\*|// patterns. Target hotfix to staging -> canary -> prod today.
Jordan (CS): Created incident ticket CS-8712 and linked the customer's x-request-id and sample body. Will update ACME once hotfix is in.
Nora (ACME): Appreciate the quick turnaround. Please let me know when full rollout is safe.
Priya (Eng:runtime): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3421 — includes fix + tests. Planning canary tomorrow morning after CI.
Liam (SRE): Closing note: added a synthetic contract test to CI that rejects any JSON output containing '/*' or '//' outside strings.
Jordan (CS): Marking this thread resolved for now, will re-open if ACME reports recurrence. :white_check_mark:
Nora (ACME): Thanks everyone :pray:
